Description: Preview or explicitly execute coordinated memory reorganization.
Arguments:
  - --execute [optional]: Apply changes (exact flag required; a verified recovery bundle is always created first).
  - mode [optional] (choices=--backup, --dedupe, --analyze, --prune, --synthesize, --verify): Run one reorganization step instead of the full operation.

  - --force-reembed [optional]: Force eligible records to be re-embedded.
  - --recover <run-id> [optional]: Inspect a retained run; add exact --execute to restore its recorded verified bundle.

The command is dry-run by default. Full mode runs dedupe, prune, synthesis, verification, and lifecycle unless a full-only skip flag is supplied. --analyze is read-only and rejects --execute. Every mutating mode first creates a verified Memory and Transcript recovery bundle; Transcript content is recovery-only and is never reorganized. Plain 'execute' and --no-backup are rejected. Recovery artifacts and the owner-only categorical log are retained; use the exact --recover forms shown above after recovery_required.
